description: Start a workflow run (one submit) and wait up to wait_seconds (≤ 45) for it to finish. Completed → the final output; still running → run_id: call check_workflow_run with it, never resubmit (a new run bills again). Each step is billed as an ordinary request. webhook_url gets ONE signed workflow.completed / workflow.failed delivery when the run ends. Get workflow_id and the inputs shape from list_workflows. Needs a Relay credential.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency-Key for the submit: the same key and inputs within 24 h return the same run_id instead of a new run. Generated when omitted.

inputs.description: Template inputs, an object matching the workflow's input_schema.

store_output.description: Run-level storage for every media step: `provider` (default, 1 h link) or `relay1d` / `relay7d` / `relay30d` (billed per file, see get_pricing).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for it to finish (0–45, default 45); 0 returns the run_id at once.

webhook_url.description: HTTPS URL for one signed workflow.completed / workflow.failed delivery when the run ends.

workflow_id.description: Workflow template id from list_workflows, e.g. `script-voiceover`.

name: run_workflow
title: Run a workflow
